how: Nelder-Mead on the mean return of 12 random 30 s training episodes (seeds 100-111) at 20 Hz, sensor delays and noise on, no randomisation; scripts/train.py pi
loops_how: first order plus dead time of each decoupled channel at 40 bar / ROF 3.4, fitted to the first 3 s of a step; dead time includes the sensor delay and half a control interval (pi.identify_loops)
bandwidth_how: grid search over 36 pairs of loop bandwidths on the 12 training episodes, by mean return (-225.2); scripts/train.py pi
